descripcion: Offline Android root toolkit for Samsung Galaxy (S23-S26 / Z Flip / Z Fold / Tab S9 Ultra). DF chain (DirtyFrag) first, auto-fallback to the SRK chain (CVE-2026-43499, firmware-matched payloads), then DFReroot persistence. KernelSU & KernelSU-Next. For security research only.
